_comment: RDroid model records (2026-11-14), only the fields the code reads where they were checked: rdModel3_NewEntry zeroes the 0x90-byte model and copies the name; rdModel3_CalcRadii walks geoset 0's meshes (0x7c bytes) and stores each radius as a float at +0x60 (as int * the twin stored an integer); rdModel3_CalcVertexNormals walks every geoset (8-byte records from +0x24, count at +0x44). Typing rdModel3_CalcRadii's parameter did not help (the decompiler walks a pointer into the middle of each mesh, at dwVertices, and stores puVar4[6] as uint), so no function uses these yet.

structs.name: rdMesh
structs.comment: One mesh of a model geoset (0x7c bytes)
fields: 0x4c-byte faces: index count +0x14, index array +0x18, normal +0x40
largest vertex distance from the origin * 1.1 (rdModel3_CalcRadii)
